name: Lemonade
description: A bright splash of citrus joy
incredients: Lemon juice – 2 tbsp.Water – 1 cup.Sugar – 2 tbsp.Ice cubes
recipe: Lemon juice, water, sugar, ice. Mix well and serve chilled.

name: Iced Tea
description: Cool comfort with a bold taste
incredients: Tea bags / tea powder – 2. Water – 2 cups. Sugar or honey – 2 tbsp (adjust to taste). Lemon slices – optional. Mint leaves – optional. Ice cubes – as required
recipe: Boil water in a pan.Add tea bags or tea powder and steep for 3–5 minutes.Strain the tea if using tea powder.Add sugar or honey while the tea is hot and mix well.Let the tea cool to room temperature.Fill a glass with ice cubes.Pour the cooled tea over the ice.Garnish with lemon slices and mint leaves.Serve chilled.

name: Virgin Mojito
incredients: Fresh mint leaves, lemon juice, sugar syrup, soda water, and ice cubes.
recipe: Start by gently muddling mint leaves with lemon juice and sugar syrup in a glass. Add ice cubes, pour in soda water, stir lightly, and serve chilled.

name: Falooda
description: A royal dessert in a glass
incredients: chilled milk, cooked falooda sev, soaked basil seeds, rose syrup, and ice cream.
recipe: MBegin by adding rose syrup to a tall glass. Layer the soaked basil seeds and cooked falooda sev, then pour in chilled milk. Top with a scoop of ice cream and serve immediately.

name: Bubble Tea
description: Every sip comes with a surprise
incredients: tapioca pearls, black tea, milk, and sugar syrup to taste.
recipe: boil the tapioca pearls until soft and chewy, then drain them. Brew black tea and allow it to cool. Mix the tea with milk and sugar syrup, add the cooked pearls to a glass, pour in the tea mixture, and serve cold.

name: Green Tea
incredients: Green tea leaves / bag – 1. Hot water – 1 cup
recipe: Heat the water until just below boiling. Add the green tea leaves or tea bag and steep for about two minutes. Remove the leaves or bag and serve warm.

name: Matcha Latte
incredients: matcha powder, hot water, milk, and honey or sugar if preferred.
recipe: Start by whisking matcha powder with hot water until smooth. Heat the milk separately, then pour it into the matcha mixture. Sweeten if needed, mix well, and serve hot.

name: Sugarcane Juice
incredients: Sugarcane – crushed Lemon juice – few drops. Ginger – optional
recipe: Fresh sugarcane juice with lemon and ginger.

name: Golden Milk
incredients: Milk – 1 cup.Turmeric powder – ½ tsp.Black pepper – a pinch.Honey or sugar – to taste
recipe: MHeat milk on low flame.Add turmeric and black pepper.Stir well and simmer 2 minutes.Sweeten and serve warm.

name: Masala Chai
incredients: Water – 1 cup.Milk – 1 cup.Tea powder – 1 tsp.Ginger – crushed.Cardamom – crushed.Sugar – to taste
recipe: Boil water with ginger and cardamom.Add tea powder and boil 1–2 minutes.Pour milk and add sugar.Simmer, strain, and serve hot.

name: Hot Chocolate
incredients: Milk – 1 cup.Cocoa powder – 1 tbsp.Sugar – 1–2 tbsp (to taste).Dark chocolate (optional) – 1 tbsp, chopped.Vanilla essence – few drops (optional)
recipe: Heat the milk in a saucepan on low flame (do not boil).Add cocoa powder and sugar to the milk.Stir continuously to avoid lumps.Add chopped dark chocolate for extra richness (optional).Simmer for 2–3 minutes until smooth and slightly thick.Add vanilla essence and mix well.Pour into a cup and serve hot.
